methodology.local_proxy_capture: counts and sizes only; no prompt, completion or credential text is retained
methodology.pair_order: alternated by case and repeat with order offset 0; serialized requests
methodology.case_set: conversation-v1; 8 selected conversational scenarios from the 50-case seed corpus, 3 repetitions, 48 user turns per stack
methodology.provider_generation_count: measured as provider proxy requests associated with each serialized user turn

limitations: Synthetic chat-only subset; this does not qualify the 50-case corpus.
Owner preference and quality review were not collected.

Memory, domain tools, Open WebUI, coding/action and production parity were not measured; pantry/weekend prompts intentionally run without their required data/tools to inspect graceful limitation handling.
The HADES-only overlay instruction changes the model request; that is part of the measured product tax.

The v1 conversation set selects eight cases or follow-up slices from the 50-case corpus. It does not cover domain mutations, private memory with seeded owner facts, authenticated UI, real coding edits/tests/Git, computer use, or long-running work.
Ollama ran with OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD=1 and effective context fixed to 4,096. The staged Qwen digest differs from the production model digest; results are local comparative evidence only.
